parameters.title: The row's words.
parameters.subtitle: A second line under them.
parameters.leading: A glyph or a badge before them.
parameters.trailing: A control at the row's end (a switch, a checkbox).
parameters.trailingText: A value at the row's end.
parameters.onTap: Called when the row is pressed; null: the row is not a control.
parameters.selected: Whether the row is the one shown beside the list (a list beside its detail).
parameters.showChevron: Whether a chevron shows at the end; by default when onTap is set and no trailing control is.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Whether the row destroys something: its words in the danger ink.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says for the row, when not its words.
parameters.style: This row's own style, over ClayThemeData.listTileStyle.
